name: The Sunday Room
description: A sunny corner cafe serving slow-brewed coffee and fresh pastries, with mismatched armchairs and plenty of window seats.
tip: Arrive before nine for the best seats by the window.

name: Saltwater Steps
description: A series of wide stone steps leading down to the water, popular for sunrise walks and a quiet swim.
tip: Wear shoes with grip because the lower steps stay slippery.

name: Ink & Paper
description: A tiny independent bookshop and stationer packed with notebooks, pens, and carefully chosen second-hand paperbacks.
tip: Ask the owner for recommendations from the back shelf.
